rationale: With only 6 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation, creating unacceptable slippage risk especially given today's already negative P&L. The price is consolidating tightly near the day's low (11.7% of range) with no clear directional catalyst — the last 5 candles show a narrow $0.05 range with no momentum. The risk/reward of entering a position that must be closed at market in minutes does not justify the trade.
